title: THE CAPON ODYSSEY // FOURTEEN PAGES OF CHIN GREASE
narrative: You turn the page expecting Daenerys to confront the Others or Arya to assassinate Cersei. Instead, the chapter begins: 'The capon was roasted with honey and crushed cloves, and as Lord Bolton bit into the crispy leg, hot glistening yellow grease dribbled down his pale chin, pooling in the crevices of his doublet...' The description continues for four pages. Then five pages on lamprey pie. Then four pages on trenchers soaked in mutton gravy. Fourteen pages later, Stannis has not moved an inch.
resolvesPlotHole: GRRM's Pathological Need to Describe Medieval Food
introducesPlotHole: Fourteen Pages of Pure Capon Grease Description
